name: Handysize
description: Smallest bulk carrier class. Self-loading/unloading with cranes. Fits ALL ports including draft-restricted Haldia.

name: Supramax
description: Versatile geared bulk carrier equipped with 4x30 MT cranes and grabs. Workhorse for Indonesian coal imports and shallow-draft ports.

name: Panamax
description: Standard gearless dry bulk vessel historically sized for original Panama Canal locks. Primary workhorse for coal imports to Paradip, Vizag Inner, and Gopalpur.

name: Capesize
description: Large heavy dry bulk carrier too large for Panama Canal, traditionally navigating via Cape of Good Hope. Requires deepwater ports like Gangavaram, Dhamra, Vizag Outer, or lighterage at Sandheads.
